before.name: Patricia McCormick
before.description: Sister of Loretto raised on a farm northwest of Chicago, served in Bolivia in 1965 where she met Daniel Berrigan during her formation in Cuernavaca. After returning to Denver she trained at the Ground Zero Center for Nonviolent Action and formed an interfaith group vigiling at Rocky Flats' west gate. In April 1983 she and a Mennonite friend entered the Rocky Flats plant and poured a vial of blood on a facility sign; she was charged with a misdemeanor and served two months in jail.

credit: Provided photo, via National Catholic Reporter / Global Sisters Report; interview by Dawn Araujo-Hawkins, July 8, 2017.
